title: An Inconvenient Life
content:
Lyndsay Rush, who describes herself as a “part-time poet, full-time dingdong”, goes by the handle of @maryoliversdrunkcousin on Instagram. Her forthcoming collection of poems is called Microdosing Hope (out in March 2027). I liked this one she shared recently, called An Inconvenient Life:

I want a dumb phone and a smart president
I want slow fashion and fast friends
I want to be bored and benevolent, silly and still
I want innovation that doesn’t kill and news that doesn’t break
I want your email to find me lingering and lallygagging
pondering and present
I don’t want to save time just to waste it;
Staring at screens of various sizes
Tapping away the years
Scrolling past everything that makes a good life
good
